Embed rows in 2 or 3 dimensions (t-SNE)

Exact t-SNE of the chosen numeric columns (scikit-learn's method=exact, init=pca), standardised by default; adds tsne_0..tsne_n beside the input (null on rows missing a feature). Every row is compared with every other, so large tables need sampling first.

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Columns | Feature columns | `feature_cols` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Comma-separated numeric features; empty auto-detects numeric columns. |
| Columns | Label column | `label_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Optional column excluded from automatic feature detection. |
|   | n_components | `n_components` | Integer | `2` | `2-3` | The run | Output dimensions (2 or 3) |
|   | perplexity | `perplexity` | Integer | `30` | `1-2147483647` | The run | About how many neighbours each row keeps close; below the rows used. |
|   | learning_rate | `learning_rate` | Number | `0` |   | The run | Step size of the layout; 0: auto (rows / 48, at least 50, as scikit-learn) |
|   | iterations | `iterations` | Integer | `1000` | `250-2147483647` | The run | Steps of the layout (the first 250 exaggerate early clusters) |
|   | standardise | `standardise` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Scale each feature to z-scores first. |
|   | keep_columns | `keep_columns` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Keep the input columns and add tsne_\* beside them. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs
